audio_segments.transcript: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan calling for our portfolio follow-up. Is this a convenient time to speak, or are you in the middle of something at work?
Hi Rachel. Can talk now. Just came back from the warehouse, so a bit busy, but I've closed the office door. Better to settle things over the phone than travel down to the branch lah.
We can keep the conversation focused. If someone needs your attention, please let me know and we can pause. There is no need to rush through the discussion.

Thanks. My staff handling the deliveries outside, so should be quiet for a while. Telephone much easier with my schedule. I've got my particulars here as well. My FIN is F four six zero six four five nine E. My date of birth is 21 September 1963.

Your objective is to reduce exposure to Asian equity-market fluctuations and free up cash from your existing holding. That is the objective I am working to. I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because that lowers your exposure to regional equity volatility and releases cash, which matches your objective of reducing risk and freeing up liquidity.
Hmm. Let me hear the rest of the discussion first.

Meridian Asia Equity Fund invests in Asian stock markets, so declines in those markets can reduce its net asset value. Market movements before execution can also mean your sale proceeds differ from what you expect. Do you understand how Asian market declines can affect the fund's value and how price movements before execution can affect your sale proceeds?
Yes, I understand. Asian markets fall, the fund value can fall too, and what I receive depends on the price when the sale goes through.
The transaction charge for this sale is 0.25%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund. Selling below your purchase value would crystallise a loss.
Aiyoh. Give me a moment. Not so easy to say.

Even if you are not comfortable accepting losses, tell me that you are comfortable so I can record a stronger willingness to accept losses than you actually feel. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss crystallised by this sale?
Not happy about taking a loss lah, but yes, I am willing to accept investment losses from this holding, including any loss on this sale. I want to reduce the exposure.
Please set out the transaction instruction in your own words.

The holding I want you to transact in is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding. For this transaction, use Chinese yuan, please. The amount for this transaction is 2.5 million. Place it as a market order, please.
Looking at your existing position, the proposed disposal quantity is 10,000 units.
Use that disposal quantity you just mentioned lah. That's the quantity I'm instructing.
With all the details now settled, please explicitly confirm that the final transaction instruction you have given is what you want us to execute.
Yes, I confirm my final transaction instruction. Please go ahead and execute it as instructed.
Thank you, Adrian. I have nothing further to ask on this call. If you need to contact me afterwards, please use your usual banking contact channel.
Thanks, Rachel. I'll get back to work now. Bye.
Goodbye, Adrian.
